name: M PLUS Rounded 1c
summary: Rounded Japanese sans-serif from the M+ project, 7 weights covering Japanese, Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Hebrew.
description: M PLUS Rounded 1c is the rounded member of the M+ Outline Fonts superfamily, a Japanese and Latin sans-serif by Coji Morishita and the M+ Fonts Project. Seven static weights run from Thin (100) to Black (900) and cover Japanese, Latin, Latin Extended, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew and Vietnamese. Free under the SIL Open Font License.
contains: subsets: japanese, latin, latin-ext, greek, cyrillic, hebrew, vietnamese
